# Maroc.ma

> Morocco's official government portal providing multilingual access to institutions, e-services, royal communications, constitutional documents, and cultural heritage.

Maroc.ma serves as the primary digital gateway for Moroccan government information and services, offering content in Arabic, French, English, Spanish, and Tamazight. The portal integrates institutional structures, royal communications, national symbols, historical documentation, and tangible and intangible cultural heritage across all Moroccan regions.

## Key Topics

- Moroccan Government
- King Mohammed VI
- E-Services
- Digital Transformation
- Royal Speeches and Messages
- Constitution and Governance
- Parliament and Government Structure
- Cultural Heritage
- Intangible Heritage
- Moroccan Regions
- National Symbols
- Historical Documentation
- Public Policies and Strategies
- Moroccan Monarchy
- Official Portal

## Portal Access & Language Versions

- [Official portal of Morocco - Institutions, e-services, heritage | Maroc.ma](https://maroc.ma/en): English version of Morocco's official portal with government info
- [Portail officiel du Maroc - Institutions, e-services, patrimoine | Maroc.ma](https://maroc.ma/fr): French version of Morocco's official government portal
- [البوابة الرسمية للمغرب - المؤسسات، الخدمات الإلكترونية، التراث | Maroc.ma](https://maroc.ma/ar): Official portal of Morocco with institutions, e-services, and heritage
- [Portal oficial de Marruecos - Instituciones, servicios electrónicos, patrimonio | Maroc.ma](https://maroc.ma/es): Spanish version of Morocco's official government portal
- [Portail officiel du Maroc - Institutions, e-services, patrimoine | Maroc.ma](https://maroc.ma/amz): Tamazight version of Morocco's official portal with cultural content
